Averages can outgrow the whole

Each bar is a store's average profit per order across every product. Pick a product line to draw that line's own average solid in front. Where it beats the overall average, the axis stretches to fit it and a dashed edge marks where the overall average ends; where it loses money, it is drawn on its own side of zero.
